what: An Indie Hackers commenter argues that switching from Gumroad has high hidden costs because all existing marketing links point to Gumroad pages across social media, forums, and messaging apps, resulting in lost sales for anyone with significant traction.
verbatim_snippet: "All your marketing was linked to the gumroad page. That means you need to update all those links. But do you honestly know and control where those links are? I don't think you will. There will be people mentioning it in Reddit comments, reddit posts, IH comments, Hacker News comments, slack messages... Changing to a competitor is probably going to result in lost sales if you've got any decent traction in social media."
